# THE INCREMENTAL = WHOLE GATE ITSELF: what decides what a takes-drift row finds -- the check script, the replay harness,
# the flip predicate and the two allow-lists. A push to main touching one of these, or carrying `New-Check:` and touching
# a drift path (.github/identity-drift-paths.txt), is a check's birth or tightening: the pre-push hook's `identitydrift`
# check runs every drift row (scripts/identity-drift-ci --against main) and refuses a row worse than main's own run --
# a new or tightened check lands green, everything it finds at birth on its allow-list as TEMPORARY
# (scripts/ci/commit_rules.py). The flip and drift gates were both born red (9bb54c1a4, a2c684f80): 15 red runs.
